references.text: For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word
As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you
For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh. So they are no longer two, but one flesh

To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband. But if she does, she must remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife
For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh
